caseStudies.title: EnCory
caseStudies.problem: Aftersales, engineering and supply chain teams worked from separate data, making it hard to optimise parts portfolios and manage returns.
delivered: Built features end to end in Angular and Spring Boot on Postgres and Azure.
Ran requirement sessions directly with the client and turned them into deliverable scope.
Kept code quality high through reviews and shared standards.

caseStudies.title: RLE
caseStudies.problem: Vehicle & Body and Powertrain & Chassis teams had to reconcile expected parts lists against what vendors actually delivered, by hand.
delivered: Built the Angular front end for matching delivered parts against functional parts lists.
Generated missing-parts lists for follow-up with vendors.
Worked directly with the client on requirements and acceptance.

caseStudies.title: Connect iPaaS
caseStudies.problem: Business users needed to connect the SaaS apps they already owned without writing integration code.
delivered: Built and maintained connectors for a dozen enterprise APIs, from Gmail and Outlook to Workday and ServiceNow.
Worked across Spring Boot microservices, the Angular UI and Docker-based AWS infrastructure.
Contributed to high- and low-level designs and R&D spikes.
